description: A person's atproto account naming the tgsocial node it belongs to (PROTOCOL.md §12.3). The node's card names the DID with `atproto.did:`; this record is the other half. A reader attributes the account's posts to the node only when both exist.

main.description: The record key is the node's Telegram username, lowercased (the `node` value), so a reader checks one node with one com.atproto.repo.getRecord and never lists the collection.

node.description: The node channel's username, lowercased, no leading @. Telegram usernames are 5-32 characters of [a-z0-9_], not starting with a digit.
